notes: Added missing contract, API exposure, testing, and facade integration stories for FEAT-3.

stories.title: Clinical Trials Search Request/Response Schema Definition
stories.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for clinical trials search inputs (condition, location, radius) and outputs (trial metadata, recruiting status, locations, distance, duration) to ensure strict contract between tool layer and domain service.

stories.title: Evaluate Care Facade Integration for Clinical Trials Search
stories.description: Integrate clinical trials service into evaluate_care_facade to expose a unified orchestration method for trial search, ensuring proper input mapping, service invocation, and response shaping for tool consumption.

stories.title: Tool Router Registration and API Exposure for Clinical Trials
stories.description: Register clinical trials search as an allowed tool in tool_router, including input validation, routing logic, and compatibility with Anthropic tool-use flow so it can be invoked from chat.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Clinical Trials Service Logic
stories.description: Create unit tests covering query construction, recruiting filter enforcement, location parsing, and distance computation logic, including edge cases such as missing locations and API failures.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing clinical_trials_service test file; must create new test module under backend/tests/

stories.title: End-to-End Integration Test for Clinical Trials Tool Flow
stories.description: Implement integration test validating full flow from tool invocation through tool_router, facade, domain service, and external API mocking, ensuring structured response is returned to chat layer.
